description: This file provides utility functions to resolve and spawn pnpm commands across different platforms, used in scripting or build automation within the project.

methods.name: resolvePnpmRunner
methods.description: Resolves the correct command and arguments for executing pnpm, considering platform differences and environment variables.

methods.name: createPnpmRunnerSpawnSpec
methods.description: Creates a spawn configuration object for running pnpm based on input parameters and resolved command.

methods.name: spawnPnpmRunner
methods.description: Spawns a child process to run pnpm with specified parameters.
